facts.summary: Missed co-primary endpoints at 2 hours; no commercialization plans · Phase 3 · STS101 in acute migraine · not yet approved

evidence.summary: STS101 was not statistically superior to placebo at two hours post-administration on the co-primary endpoints of freedom from pain and most bothersome symptom
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: these differences did not achieve statistical significance (p-value <0.05).
evidence.safety: No treatment-related serious adverse events or cardiovascular events occurred.
